title: TRF: Tri-Lateral Retention Feasibility Model — executable artefact
description:
Executable artefact for the MSc thesis Verifiable Crypto-Erasure for Cross-Border Health Data Audit Trails under the European Health Data Space (Arshad Akhtar Abbasia, Høgskolen i Molde, 2026; supervisor Prof. João Ferreira).

Contains the TRF constraint checker (Python standard library; seed 20260915, 200 synthetic records), its exhaustive cross-check, a bounded Z3 SMT check of Propositions 1–3, a Synthea FHIR R4 realism layer, a cryptographic envelope module (AES-256-GCM), Norwegian context modules and a Streamlit viewer. Every recorded output in docs/expected_*.txt reproduces byte for byte.

Scope: results are checked on generated data and are not estimates of real frequency; key destruction is simulated and treated as attested, not proven; the Streamlit app is a viewer over the checker, never a source of results.
